surface.name: gully
surface.label: Graduation Peak gully
surface.blurb: Real ground, from the Kachemak Bay 2023 lidar: the spur between two incised gullies below Graduation Peak, climbed 46 m in 193 m (24 %) between a made-up start and end. The gullies' walls are 80-120 % and hem the spur in, so how it zigzags is a trade between grade and corners on ground that is not uniform. There is no formula here: the straight line is the comparison.
